mapper.select: SELECT e.*, d.name AS department_name, des.name AS designation_name, b.name AS branch_name FROM employees e LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN designations des ON des.id = e.designation_id LEFT JOIN branches b ON b.id = e.branch_id WHERE e.id = #{id} AND e.company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE employees SET first_name = #{firstName}, last_name = #{lastName}, work_email = #{workEmail}, personal_phone = #{personalPhone}, department_id = #{departmentId}, designation_id = #{designationId}, employment_type = #{employmentType}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND company_id = #{companyId}
